# yyjson

ScriptGo vendors the `yyjson` C library for high-performance JSON parsing and serialization.

- Version: `v0.13.0`
- Revision: see `REVISION`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`
- Source: https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson

The library provides SIMD-accelerated JSON operations in `internal/runtime/native/json/`.
